sect2.title: Feature extraction
sect2.para:
Each audio sample is converted to 16-bit PCM floats, split into 8 equal sub-bands, and the following per-band statistics are computed:
RMS energy (8 values)
Zero-crossing rate (8 values) Plus four global spectral-moment features (centroid, spread, skewness, kurtosis) and four temporal features (global RMS, crest factor, peak energy, spectral flatness), totalling 24 base features. Eight delta features (consecutive sub-band RMS differences) are appended to reach 32 dimensions.
Profiles are stored as the L2-normalised average over all enrollment samples. Verification uses cosine similarity between the normalised probe vector and the stored profile vector.
